title: IP camera 0-day: pre-auth RCE to root
summary: Previously unknown bug that lets an unauthenticated attacker on the network take a root shell on a consumer IP camera. Reported to KISA; vendor and details withheld until coordinated disclosure ends.

title: PostgreSQL pgcrypto heap overflow
summary: Integer overflow in PGP session-key parsing leading to a heap overflow; built a working exploit from the advisory.

title: Exim SMTP AUTH out-of-bounds write
summary: Unauthenticated out-of-bounds write in the SMTP AUTH handler; reproduced the bug and the path to code execution.

title: ipTIME UPnP OS command injection
summary: Command injection in the UPnP service; root-cause analysis and reproduction on real firmware.
